pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which sentence means "The weather is very good today."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 今天有云。
   D. 今天下雨。

2. Read the pinyin: zhè shì wǒ jiějie. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my father.
   B. Who is this?
   C. That is my younger brother.
   D. This is my older sister.

3. Which sentence means "On Saturday I rest at home."? (1 mark)
   A. 我星期六在家休息。
   B. 明天是星期四。
   C. 今天星期三。
   D. 星期天,去教堂。

4. In the sentence 电视在桌子上, where is the television? (1 mark)
   A. In the kitchen
   B. On the table
   C. Beside the door
   D. Under the table

5. What does 大 (dà) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Snow
   B. It rains
   C. Big
   D. Drought

6. Which is the short form of 星期? (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 周
   C. 学
   D. 家

7. What is a good strategy to speak Chinese clearly? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the tones
   B. Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
   C. Speak as fast as possible
   D. Whisper all the time

8. Which word is pronounced érzi? (1 mark)
   A. 是
   B. 女儿
   C. 儿子
   D. 这

9. What does 厨房 (chúfáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Kitchen
   B. Things
   C. On
   D. Television

10. Which Chinese word means "kitchen"? (1 mark)
   A. 厨房 chúfáng
   B. 东西 dōngxi
   C. 旁边 pángbiān
   D. 里 lǐ

11. Fill the blank: 窗户在门____。 (The window is above the door.) (1 mark)
   A. 旁边
   B. 下面
   C. 左边
   D. 上面

12. What does 妈妈 (māma) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Younger brother
   B. Younger sister
   C. Father
   D. Mother

13. Fill the blank: 我____茶。 (I drink tea.) (1 mark)
   A. 去
   B. 看
   C. 喝
   D. 吃

14. What does 香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Banana
   B. Biscuits
   C. Drinks
   D. Water

15. In the Chinese week, which day is 星期一? (1 mark)
   A. Monday
   B. Saturday
   C. Tuesday
   D. Sunday

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Good morning!" (2 marks)

17. Write a paragraph of four sentences about your week in Chinese with pinyin, using the days and activities from this lesson. (5 marks)

18. Explain the sentence pattern for saying where something is, with an example. (3 marks)

19. Why is a healthy plate made from several food groups? Give an example of a food from two groups. (3 marks)

20. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very light." (2 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — 今天天气很好。
   今天天气很好。 (jīntiān tiānqì hěn hǎo.) means "The weather is very good today.".

2. D — This is my older sister.
   zhè shì wǒ jiějie. is 这是我姐姐。, which means "This is my older sister.".

3. A — 我星期六在家休息。
   我星期六在家休息。 (wǒ xīngqīliù zài jiā xiūxi.) means "On Saturday I rest at home.".

4. B — On the table
   上 means on.

5. C — Big
   大 (dà) means big.

6. B — 周
   周 zhōu means week and is used in 周一 and 周日.

7. B — Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
   Listening and copying the tone shapes helps you speak clearly.

8. C — 儿子
   儿子 is pronounced érzi and means son.

9. A — Kitchen
   厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

10. A — 厨房 chúfáng
   厨房 (chúfáng) means kitchen.

11. D — 上面
   上面 is above.

12. D — Mother
   妈妈 (māma) means mother.

13. C — 喝
   We drink tea, so we use 喝.

14. A — Banana
   香蕉 (xiāngjiāo) means banana.

15. A — Monday
   Chinese counts the days from Monday.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: 早上好! zǎoshang hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

17. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一到星期五,我去学校。星期六,我在家休息。星期天,我去教堂。 xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, wǒ qù xuéxiào. xīngqīliù, wǒ zài jiā xiūxi. xīngqītiān, wǒ qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for order and punctuation. Any sensible activities.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: Thing + 在 + place, with 上 or 下 at the end when needed. For example 电视在桌子上。
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the pattern, 1 mark for the example, 1 mark for the translation.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Each group helps the body in a different way. For example rice gives energy and spinach gives vitamins.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for saying groups do different jobs, 2 marks for examples.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很小。 fēng hěn xiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.
